title_zh: 周璇：中国早期流行音乐的「金嗓子」
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (1/20): Zhou Xuan, the "Golden Voice" of Early Chinese Pop
note_en: This text is full of 被 passives: 被称为「金嗓子」 "was called the Golden Voice," 被认为是 "is regarded as," 被一个上海家庭收养 "was adopted by a Shanghai family." Like the English passive, 被 puts the receiver of the action first; the doer can follow 被 directly (被很多人怀念 "remembered by many people") or be left out entirely, and the verb itself never changes form.
